source.title: Prospecting — firsthand 30-stack Saronite gem tally, comment 558153
source.author: myrmideon (Wowhead comment 558153)

notes: Single original firsthand Wowhead commenter reports having prospected 30 stacks of Saronite Ore on Gorefiend and lists actual received gem counts. Number of items per stack not expressly reported; do NOT convert 30 stacks into measured completed five-ore casts. 120 would only be a nominal equivalent if every stack held 20. Other locales and WotLK/PTR mirrors show the SAME comment, not independent cohorts. Exact game build/patch/skill/stat specialization, per-item cast hits/zero bins/histograms, refund operations and any item-rank are not supplied. Raw results are historical, NOT a current-Retail baseline.

source.title: Spaulders of the Wayward Vanquisher — tier 8 class reward list
source.author: Warcraft Wiki contributors

quote: It can be exchanged in Dalaran for the following items
notes: Identity and seven original tier-8 vendor-exchange reward variants corroborated by Wowhead item pages and https://www.wowhead.com/item=45661/spaulders-of-the-wayward-vanquisher (Stompa historical vendor comment). This record is explicitly the HISTORICAL vendor mapping, not proof of current Retail Use outcomes. Current Wowhead tooltip instead says 'Use: Create a class set item appropriate for your loot specialization.' Modern use reward item IDs, resolution by loot specialization, whether vendor remains eligible and game build require separate verification. Do not substitute item 45661 with 25-man Mantle of the Wayward Vanquisher.
vendor: Dalaran (Northrend): Dubin Clay for Death Knights; Valerie Langrom for Rogues and Druids; Paldesse for Mages (historical exchange)
